comment: Shared canonical-hash fixture for Panel Sync (docs/PROTOCOL.md section 5).
For each input file: parse with the given origin, strip DNSSEC/private types, canonicalise.
hash = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(hash_input)); hash_input is the sorted canonical lines with the SOA serial removed, each ending in \n.
text is what the agent pushes; re-canonicalising text gives the same text and hash.

cases.hash_input:
*.wild.example.com. 3600 IN A 192.0.2.99
_443._tcp.example.com. 3600 IN TLSA 3 1 1 AB12CD34
_sip._tcp.example.com. 3600 IN SRV 0 5 5060 sip.example.com.
caa.example.com. 3600 IN CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.example"
esc.example.com. 3600 IN TXT "ABC" "q\"uote" "back\\slash" "tab\009x"
example.com. 300 IN MX 10 mail.example.com.
example.com. 300 IN MX 20 mail2.example.net.
example.com. 3600 IN NS ns1.example.com.
example.com. 3600 IN NS ns2.example.net.
example.com. 3600 IN SOA ns1.example.com. hostmaster.example.com. 3600 900 604800 300
mail.example.com. 3600 IN A 192.0.2.10
mail.example.com. 3600 IN AAAA 2001:db8::10
ns1.sub.example.com. 3600 IN A 192.0.2.53
sub.example.com. 3600 IN DS 12345 13 2 ABCDEF0123456789
sub.example.com. 3600 IN NS ns1.sub.example.com.
txt.example.com. 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 ip4:192.0.2.0/24" " include:_spf.example.net -all"
www.example.com. 3600 IN CNAME example.com.
